mapper.insert: INSERT INTO journal_entries (id, global_journal_entry_id, journal_type, name, payment_id, tx_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{globalJournalEntryId}, #{journalType}, #{name}, #{paymentId}, #{txId}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO postings (journal_id, account_code, account_type, amount, direction, currency, created_at) VALUES (#{journalId}, #{accountCode}, #{accountType}, #{amount}, #{direction}, #{currency}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (journal_id, account_code) DO NOTHING
mapper.sql: j.id AS journal_id, j.global_journal_entry_id, j.journal_type, j.name AS journal_name, j.payment_id, j.tx_id, NULL AS reason, p.account_code, p.account_type, p.direction, p.amount, p.currency
mapper.select: SELECT FROM journal_entries j JOIN postings p ON p.journal_id = j.id WHERE j.tx_id = #{txId} ORDER BY j.created_at, j.id, p.id
SELECT FROM journal_entries j JOIN postings p ON p.journal_id = j.id WHERE j.payment_id = #{paymentId} ORDER BY j.created_at, j.id, p.id
